description.zh:
集群描述。

- 不能以`http://`或者`https`开头；
- 长度为2~256个字符。
description.en:
The description of the cluster.

*   The description cannot start with `http://` or `https`.
*   The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun adb modify-db-cluster-description --db-cluster-id am-bp11q28kvl6880000 --db-cluster-description adb_test --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
